items.markdown:
You do not actually get a higher blood alcohol content (BAC) on a plane, but you often **feel** more drunk.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXolXSBGaMDcIRhAeyWgY9eAJd3BAi2KZUpXY_Izoab2K437kR0Cjyyygn_alguVe-ePgV5hHGnH3ExXt62kQUl1-Il_TvgcVPh0uYc_S5qkj9O1A00sN7Ynr6z2e8TmXbC-z1ilf3KREDWIu-WvTJ0VKOwM1-Y6Lumek)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXSJnsAPZuEbczM0xLopIKe8i5VGwiIYpga3WeSf_-Fv2WayWahCFGUmvJzGG_kBXikUS0EMxThYjGOQbv0KUgxOdTntcyoTrGnCPO7Ye3WA3LBZVJmiVJBHgH0j75Z7Qp)

### Why It Feels Stronger

- **Lower oxygen (mild hypoxia):** Airplane cabins are pressurized to the equivalent of 6,000–8,000 feet. Lower oxygen levels cause lightheadedness and fatigue that stack with alcohol's effects. As highlighted by [Harvard Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF15fQVCATQPoT6nn9LRA8ynPxyWItSD4XYh06lNmK1U65l4BzgJxy1bsUg11T-e1NqSKoplgVpMJbBfvzW6WF_It1oqn-9v8M--tEmVh3DqwcxemP5km-lQi6NlVrqhcnTGoxEfSTZoK8dW14wUo3PFEVDFER7XzYOLG27HQ2NTi0rvAGy6_A5nyTi28NfzXZUyQ5i_0) , combining alcohol with cabin pressure—especially while sleeping—can lower blood oxygen and raise heart rate.
- **Dehydration:** Dry cabin air pulls moisture from your body, worsening dizziness and hangovers.
- **Drinking habits:** Boredom, travel stress, or dry air making you thirsty can lead to drinking faster than you would on the ground. Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpgEBxCJF12xrAebZRVj3UW5PYjRIuvltUG1dLsIr-J3Ab2AY8HkQJnTvhAISoM90R9M1h6yMcfh5GsC_NSZHwQVrOw4cOB_9i91n9PNfscslrv7ZYLtpcBeYQPEBzxEf5iZA7MB9bmw76iorXqpV8sfRAcqXgqN8EUMRKls4KcmyaZbWbkCGDxpMp1G4VZSscVlRQWMZmMKW9Wyb5uXu1tol8B_vu5hT) agree that cabin air pressure, dehydration, and drinking faster contribute to feeling more intoxicated mid-flight.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXHl8Fqrj50_hBV6RaBDNvn0tWVz1gdCRwH73yATEFIsH_CWcQqgq97N5jeUF4FFWn9fqD_8iC2Cl75IVSvxRxIiSwRbauqzaSkfI6ZguQjChzMruY2Z14mV-Sd8aC5kYxi0KHNVo6q5YGpDKFBIgom6UZwRenaW4kXg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXhF4xkSm7v3ss_PITdI5B5P0TDtTgkYKFfxXSNPf47uMD7UpGx1R_N3YsOJaOWgdvUoUmeagj-CKarFKaCl-RkB__J6mDQ0qscTkoQqurbZDQEE6HTXoG6z56n05DLEa8aUFEgc5Azw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1-I1HgFkvHXV0dWnVoMfvo6pZ8ZaZ87EG5Z3oRp70nmbN4o-jXazGaRaDeTuSeudc9ifPmTGM59GjHukn366qgZsgHMqOMmASWaDAvoUeQDhugckZPxOf29yBR1RqfMz1AOamO41cO7Y02qpEYySkq0uusc5Bv6Q3sD1jHvDLkkfXy7Q)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXolXSBGaMDcIRhAeyWgY9eAJd3BAi2KZUpXY_Izoab2K437kR0Cjyyygn_alguVe-ePgV5hHGnH3ExXt62kQUl1-Il_TvgcVPh0uYc_S5qkj9O1A00sN7Ynr6z2e8TmXbC-z1ilf3KREDWIu-WvTJ0VKOwM1-Y6Lumek)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF15fQVCATQPoT6nn9LRA8ynPxyWItSD4XYh06lNmK1U65l4BzgJxy1bsUg11T-e1NqSKoplgVpMJbBfvzW6WF_It1oqn-9v8M--tEmVh3DqwcxemP5km-lQi6NlVrqhcnTGoxEfSTZoK8dW14wUo3PFEVDFER7XzYOLG27HQ2NTi0rvAGy6_A5nyTi28NfzXZUyQ5i_0)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpgEBxCJF12xrAebZRVj3UW5PYjRIuvltUG1dLsIr-J3Ab2AY8HkQJnTvhAISoM90R9M1h6yMcfh5GsC_NSZHwQVrOw4cOB_9i91n9PNfscslrv7ZYLtpcBeYQPEBzxEf5iZA7MB9bmw76iorXqpV8sfRAcqXgqN8EUMRKls4KcmyaZbWbkCGDxpMp1G4VZSscVlRQWMZmMKW9Wyb5uXu1tol8B_vu5hT)

- Pace yourself and eat food rather than drinking on an empty stomach.
